0022600203.text: The Atlanta Hawks, 7-4 and 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East, host the 8-2 Los Angeles Lakers, who are 1st in the Pacific and 3rd in the West, in the Hawks' 12th game of the 2026-27 season. Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee), Jock Landale (hip), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Asa Newell (toe) and Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation) are listed as day-to-day, while Los Angeles is missing Luka Doncic (back soreness). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 series was split 1-1, with the Hawks' most recent meeting a 141-116 loss in Los Angeles on January 13, 2026.
